content: Hugo: defaultContentLanguage in config; UI/theme strings come from i18n/<lang>.toml (or yaml) catalogs in project root and themes; project files override theme files key-by-key; setting defaultContentLanguage switches all built-in theme text. Content translation is separate: filename suffixes (index.pt.md) or per-language content directories. Recent Hugo improved default-language fallback for missing i18n strings. mdBook: no built-in i18n; ecosystem solution is mdbook-i18n-helpers (gettext-based, used by google/comprehensive-rust and ord) providing PO-file workflows, translated books and language pickers. Pattern: single top-level default-language knob + per-language message catalogs is the norm; gettext is the common substrate (Sphinx, mdBook helpers, fish-shell).
